title: Couple Special
subtitle: 2N Sri Vijaya Puram, 2N Swaraj Dweep, 2N Shaheed Dweep

itinerary.overviewSubtitle: 2N Sri Vijaya Puram, 2N Swaraj Dweep, 2N Shaheed Dweep

days.title: Arrival, Cellular Jail, Carbyns Cove Beach, Light & Sound Show
activities: Morning: Arrival at Sri Vijaya Puram and check-in at the hotel.
Afternoon: Visit the historic Cellular Jail, followed by a trip to Carbyn's Cove Beach.
Evening: Attend the Light and Sound Show at the Cellular Jail to learn about the history of the freedom struggle, followed by a night stay at the hotel.

days.title: Swaraj Dweep, Elephant Island & Kaalapathar Beach
activities: Morning: Take a cruise trip to Swaraj Dweep, check in at the resort, and get settled.
Afternoon: Head out for an exciting boat trip to Elephant Island Beach.
Evening: Enjoy a sunset visit to Kaalapathar Beach before returning for a night stay at Swarajdweep.

days.title: Scuba Diving & Radhanagar Beach
activities: Morning: Experience scuba diving for two adults and explore the vibrant marine life.
Afternoon: Spend time at the world-famous Radhanagar Beach, perfect for swimming and relaxation.
Evening: Night stay at the resort.

days.title: Shaheed Dweep, Coral Bridge & Laxmanpur Beach
activities: Morning: Cruise to Shaheed Dweep, check in at the resort, and visit the natural Coral Bridge (comfortable footwear recommended).
Afternoon: Leisure time to explore the island at your pace.
Evening: Capture the sunset at Laxmanpur Beach before a night stay at the resort.

days.title: Bharatpur, Sitapur & Ramnagar Beaches
activities: Morning: Visit Bharatpur Beach for water sports and picturesque views.
Afternoon: Continue to Sitapur Beach, famed for its peaceful setting and golden sands.
Evening: Wrap up the day at Ramnagar Beach before the night stay at the hotel.

days.title: Return to Sri Vijaya Puram, City Tour & Shopping
activities: Morning: Cruise back to Sri Vijaya Puram and check in at the hotel.
Afternoon: Enjoy a mini city tour covering museums and highlights of the capital.
Evening: Indulge in shopping before settling in for the night at the hotel.

days.title: Departure
activities: Morning: Airport drop with beautiful memories.
